title: Velvety Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Asian-inspired dish made with tender beef and a rich velvety sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and broccoli, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the velvety sauce, soy sauce, and garlic.
Pour the sauce over the beef and vegetables, and stir to coat.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
